component.name: OpenClaude Desktop
component.summary: Unofficial open-source desktop client for Claude

description.p: OpenClaude Desktop is an independent, open-source desktop client for Claude on Linux. It talks to the Anthropic API directly with your own API key, keeps every conversation in a local SQLite database, and stores your key in the system keyring.
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic. "Claude" is a trademark of Anthropic, PBC and is used here only to describe what the client connects to.

ul.li: Streaming replies with Markdown and syntax highlighting
Conversations persisted locally and restored after a restart
Instant full-text search across your whole history
File, image and PDF attachments by drag and drop
